checks.detail: The durable preflight built all binaries and passed 75 Rust tests, including model selection, native framing, bridge, manifest, and signal cleanup cases.
Final-tree formatting and strict Clippy gates passed.
Ran with an isolated temporary RUSTUP_HOME and removed it afterward.
Typecheck, 68 tests, deterministic build, live syntax, naming, docs, and both capability receipts passed.
The only fault-host-class check; production-chain claims do not depend on it.
Exact value, UTF-16 caret, and one input event across five text/caret categories.
Synthetic CompositionEvent lifecycle stimulus in real Chromium; not a physical IME claim.

checks.command: durable live-run verified temporary tree, broker socket, and tracked processes absent

conditions: Chromium 132 or later; exercised on Chromium 151.0.7922.173 Arch Linux
Connected, visible, enabled, writable light-DOM element with stable identity
Active non-incognito, non-discarded, non-frozen tab sender snapshot with focused window and active nonempty document identity
Collapsed selection, focused visible document, and no active composition
No recognized sensitive purpose, ancestor opt-out, or insertion-altering constraint
scope.display_route: System Chromium content script to MV3 worker to shipped Rust native host to private peer-UID-checked Unix socket, broker, and deterministic provider
scope.insertion_route: Trusted keyboard gesture, addressed broker authorization, final focus/revision/fingerprint revalidation, one setRangeText edit, and one InputEvent

protections: One public development extension identity, one exact document_idle content script, nativeMessaging as the only API permission, no host or optional permissions, no fallback matching, and declaratively disabled incognito operation

The worker fails closed unless Chrome supplies exact extension/origin/URL/top-frame identity and literal active, non-incognito, non-discarded, non-frozen, active-document state plus a nonempty document ID; routes never migrate across tab/frame/document

The content controller requires real focus at acquisition, request, response, and commit, ignores untrusted keyboard actions, and clears on window blur, visibility, policy, DOM, composition, navigation, pause, or transport invalidation
Recognized password and one-time-code fields are denied before outbound context or provider work; the live run observed zero context, call, and input-byte deltas
Chrome-native and broker framing reject envelopes above 65536 bytes before body allocation and validate strict versioned envelope shapes
The native host validates the exact trailing-slash caller origin, private socket metadata, and peer UID before bridging; normal failure output is content-free
Broker actions bind session, focus epoch, revision, fingerprint, and suggestion identity with latest-wins cancellation, receiver-local TTL, and single-use commit authorization

The durable runner uses disposable HOME/XDG/profile/manifest paths, never reads the real Chromium profile, records no context/suggestion/fingerprint values or personal paths, and proves cleanup before writing evidence
The V2 receipt binds the raw run, exact extension build, fixture, runner, fault host, and manifest policy through byte counts and SHA-256 digests
exclusions: Runtime-granted origin permission, headed consent and revocation UX, arbitrary origins, restricted/file schemes, iframes, and incognito
Current-state tab/window arbitration after the Chrome-supplied sender snapshot, background visibility on this headless build, MV3 worker restart, and cross-connection policy epochs
Browser-native undo grouping and headed extension-command accelerator delivery, both reported unsupported by the raw run
Physical IME behavior; composition coverage uses synthetic lifecycle events inside real Chromium
contenteditable, shadow targets, framework-controlled editors, anonymous/duplicate identities, and selection replacement
Headed Wayland/compositor rendering, accessibility contrast, browser-chrome zoom, hostile-page sabotage, and broad browser/site compatibility
A trusted or authenticated localhost page server; the exact URL is a disposable development fixture boundary, not page provenance
Same-UID broker or native-host impersonation and secrets placed in ordinary unmarked text fields
Semantic/local-model quality, personalization, remote providers, Obsidian, terminal/Fcitx/IBus, packaging, production identity, naming, licensing, and release readiness
notes: The final durable report was produced from clean implementation commit 068db9fe389fd7777bd903021b9c2baf3bde5140 with working_tree_dirty recorded as false before the evidence file was rewritten.

The delayed stale-response scenario alone uses a separately classified JavaScript fault host; full-chain, privacy, insertion, pause, lifecycle, and latency evidence use the shipped Rust host and broker.
The raw run also records a passing provisional edit-to-visible check; it is raw-only rather than promoted to a V2 release measurement.
Undo, headless background visibility, and the extension shortcut are explicitly unsupported rather than inferred from adjacent passing checks.
Fixed public fixture and completion strings remain in repository test source, but no runtime context, suggestion, or context-fingerprint value is present in the evidence JSON.
SHA-256 links expose repository drift; they are not signatures, remote attestation, or proof against substitution inside the trusted same-UID local boundary.
M2A is a controlled development integration record, not the full headed M2 capability cell or a production support claim.
